primary_objective: Land on the pad at (0,0) with legs in contact, minimizing time and fuel use.
state_space_summary: 8-dim: normalized x, y, linear velocities (x,y), angle, angular velocity, two leg contact booleans.
action_space_summary: Discrete: 0=do nothing, 1=fire left orientation engine, 2=fire main engine, 3=fire right orientation engine.
intended_behavior_phases: Phase 1: Stabilize and descend toward pad vicinity using main engine and orientation corrections.
Phase 2: Fine-tune horizontal position and vertical velocity for soft landing on pad.
Phase 3: Touch down with both legs on pad, zero velocity, upright orientation.
necessary_behaviors: Use main engine to control vertical descent rate.
Use orientation engines to maintain upright angle and correct horizontal drift.
Avoid crashing (body contact with ground) and going out-of-bounds (|x|>=1).
Maintain lander awake (non-zero velocity or contact).
success_signals_available_to_reward: Both legs in contact with ground (state[6]==1 and state[7]==1).
Lander position near (0,0) (state[0] and state[1] close to 0).
Low linear and angular velocities at touchdown.
Episode termination without crash or out-of-bounds.
failure_or_stop_signals_available_to_rew: Lander not awake (state becomes stationary without ground contact).
dangerous_local_optima: Hovering indefinitely at safe altitude without landing (avoids crash but never succeeds).
Landing off-pad but with legs down (avoids crash but misses primary objective).
Excessive orientation engine use causing oscillation or fuel waste without progress.
primary_selection_metric: Success rate of landing on pad with both legs in contact and low velocity.
reward_design_constraints: Reward must be computed from state, m_power, s_power, and terminated flag only.
Must return a scalar reward and a dictionary of individual reward components.
Encourage landing on pad (primary) while penalizing crash and out-of-bounds heavily.
Provide dense shaping for progress (e.g., distance reduction, velocity control) to avoid sparse reward issue.
Keep fuel penalty mild to avoid discouraging necessary engine use.
Avoid positive reward for hovering or off-pad landing.
